Three account families plus a separate challenge.

Express to Live, Fundamental and Premium make up the Phidias 2.0 account structure. The 10K Drawdown Challenge operates separately as a ranked competition.

01 / E2L Replaces Static

Express to Live

The static-drawdown route, available from 25K to 150K, with its own Switch to Live mechanism.

  • Static drawdown that does not follow profits.
  • No minimum evaluation days.
  • No consistency rule during evaluation or CASH.
  • Overnight and weekend holding are not allowed.
View Express to Live details
02 / Fundamental Retained family

Fundamental

The established intraday structure, available in 50K, 100K and 150K, with trailing drawdown calculated at end of day.

  • Three minimum evaluation days.
  • Published fixed trader share of 80%.
  • Ten qualifying days between CASH payout requests.
  • Transition to LIVE is subject to discretionary review.
View Fundamental details
03 / Premium Replaces Swing

Premium

The family that allows overnight and weekend holding, with a progressive trader share and a shorter CASH payout cycle.

  • One minimum evaluation day.
  • Five qualifying days between CASH payout requests.
  • Published progressive trader share from 75% to 100%.
  • One CASH reset may be available under the published conditions.
View Premium details

The evaluation and CASH phases are simulated. Express to Live follows a transition mechanism defined by the rules. For Fundamental and Premium, any transition to LIVE depends on a discretionary review and is not guaranteed. The 10K Drawdown Challenge is presented separately below.

What you should understand before purchasing from Phidias.

What are the three Phidias 2.0 account families?

Phidias 2.0 includes Express to Live, Fundamental and Premium. Express to Live replaces the former Static program, Fundamental remains, and Premium replaces the former Swing program.

Is the 10K Drawdown Challenge a standard Phidias account?

No. It is a competition on a simulated $10,000 account, separate from Express to Live, Fundamental and Premium evaluations. The published Summer Edition runs from July 1 to September 30, 2026, with registration available until September 23, 2026.

Are evaluation and CASH accounts simulated?

Yes. Evaluation and CASH phases are simulated. Transition to LIVE depends on the route, the current rules and, for Fundamental and Premium, a discretionary decision that is not guaranteed.

Which platforms are available at Phidias?

Phidias lists Rithmic, DeepCharts, Tradovate, NinjaTrader and TradingView execution via Tradovate.

What does code LUCAS provide?

LUCAS is the Lucas Prop Firm affiliate code for Phidias. Because promotions and prices are dynamic, check its effect in the official checkout before payment.

Which account allows overnight and weekend holding?

Premium allows overnight and weekend positions under the published rules. Express to Live and Fundamental do not.

Are the Discord prices final?

No. The amounts shown are the prices displayed on the Lucas Prop Firm homepage on July 14, 2026. The price displayed on Whop when you register remains authoritative.
